author: Rational Animations
description:
Will the world end on Friday, November 13th, 2026? That date may be a bit too specific, but it really was a scientific prediction about when hyperbolic growth would lead to a singularity (if somewhat tongue-in-cheek). In this video, we explore how and why AI could restore history’s trend of ever-faster production, what an AI-powered industrial explosion might look like, and the dangers of a “software-only singularity,” where AI could take off without any new hardware at all.
